meta.name: compliance-legal
meta.description: Map the product against applicable regulatory, contractual, and platform compliance frameworks: GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, COPPA, FedRAMP, DPDP (India), LGPD (Brazil), KVKK (Türkiye), PDPL (Saudi/UAE), ePrivacy, AI Act (EU), NIST AI RMF, store-platform legal terms (App Store, Google Play, Steam), open-source license obligations, accessibility law (ADA, EAA, Section 508, AODA), and any product-domain-specific rules (FinTech, HealthTech, EdTech, kids). Produces an applicability matrix, per-framework gap analysis, data-processing register, DPIA/AIPIA when triggered, vendor sub-processor list, and a release-gate verdict that names the binding constraints. Use early in init for products entering regulated markets, and as a recurring gate before any release that adds regions, data types, integrations, or AI capabilities.

copy.tagline: 对照各国法规,列出产品上线前的合规风险与硬性约束
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你的产品要进入受监管行业或多国市场,担心触碰合规红线。
copy.tagline_en: Map your product against global compliance rules and flag launch-blocking constraints.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your product targets regulated industries or multiple countries and you worry about compliance.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在发布前对照法规(如 GDPR、HIPAA、AI Act)和平台规则做合规体检:判定哪些法规适用、列出差距、记录数据处理活动,并给出发布裁决(可发布/有条件/暂缓)。
howto.when: 产品要进入受监管市场,或每次发布新增地区、数据类型、集成或 AI 能力时触发。

say.text: 我们要在欧盟上线,先做 GDPR 合规检查。
say.note: Claude 会生成适用性矩阵和差距清单。

say.text: 这个版本新增了用户位置数据,请跑合规排查。
say.note: 它会检查适用的数据保护法规并列出缺口。

say.text: 我们打算加 AI 推荐功能,做一次 AI 影响评估。
say.note: 针对 AI 应用评估风险与合规要求。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude checks a product against regulations (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, AI Act) and platform rules before release: it determines which frameworks apply, flags gaps, logs data-processing activities, and issues a release verdict (go / conditional / hold).
howto.when_en: Triggered when a product enters a regulated market, or before any release that adds regions, data types, integrations, or AI capabilities, as a recurring release gate.

say_en.text: We plan to launch in the EU; run a GDPR compliance check.
say_en.note: Claude produces an applicability matrix and gap list.

say_en.text: This release adds user location data; please run a compliance review.
say_en.note: It checks applicable data-protection rules and lists gaps.

say_en.text: We plan to add an AI recommendation feature; do an AI impact assessment.
say_en.note: It assesses risks and compliance requirements for the AI use.
